div.head: Af 19.3
div.ab: Gif sweordhwita oþres monnes wæpn to feormunge onfó, oððe smið monnes ondweorc, hy hit gesund begen agifen, swa hit heora hwæðer ær onfenge, buton heora hweðer ær ðingode, þæt he hit angylde healdan ne þorfte.

Gif sweordhwita oðres monnes wæpn to feormunge onfó, oððe smið monnes andweorc, hie hit gesund begen agifan, swa hit hwæðer hiora ǽr onfenge, buton hiora hwæðer ǽr þingode, þæt he hit angylde healdan ne ðorfte.

Si quis forbator alicuius arma susceperit ad purgandum, uel faber alicuius opus faciendum, ipsi hoc quietum reddant sicut exceperunt, nisi aliquis eorum ante composuit, cur hoc angilde seruare non debeant.

Gif sweordhwita oðres monnes wæpn to feormunge onfó, oððe smið monnes andweorc, hie hit gesund begen agifan, swa hit hwæðer hiora ǽr onfenge, buton hiora hwæðer ǽr þingode, þæt he hit angylde healdan ne ðorfte.

If a sword-polisher takes another person’s weapon to [re]furbish, or a smith someone’s tool, they must both give it back unhurt just as they received it earlier, unless the two of them earlier agreed, that he [the craftsman] might not be held [liable] for compensation for it.

If a sword-furbisher receives a weapon or smith receives a tool belonging to another man in order to refurbish it, in either case the article shall be returned in as good condition as that in which it has been received, unless it has been stipulated that there shall be no liability on the part of the said furbisher for damage done to it.

If a sword-polisher receives another man’s weapon to polish it, or a smith a man’s tool, they both are to give it back unstained, just as either of them had received it; unless either of them had stipulated that he need not be liable to compensation for it.

Wenn ein Schwertfeger eines anderen Mannes Waffe zur Reinigung empfängt oder ein Schmid jemandes Werkzeug, sollen sie beide es unbefleckt [von Blutschuld] zurückliefern, wie es jeder von ihnen zuvor empfangen hat: es sei denn, jeder von ihnen hätte zuvor [mit dem Eigenthümer] ausbedungen, dass er es [nur] ohne Ersatzpflicht [für etwa befleckte Waffe] zu bewahren brauchte.

If a sword-polisher receives another man’s weapon for cleaning, or a smith a person’s tool, let them both give it back unstained [by blood-guilt], as each of them received it before: unless either of them had stipulated before [with the owner] that he need keep it [only] without liability for compensation [for a weapon that might be stained].
div.note: Without it having been used to commit a crime.
